files.name: Board coupon 2×2
files.check: Four keyways. Every key and the hook go into this.

files.name: TURN key A (clamp 0.00 mm, 1 notch)
files.check: Push in upright, turn to horizontal. Note: turns by hand? clicks? wobbles? A is the loosest.

files.name: TURN key B (clamp 0.10 mm, 2 notches)
files.check: Push in upright, turn to horizontal. Note: turns by hand? clicks? wobbles? B is the current design.

files.name: TURN key C (clamp 0.20 mm, 3 notches)
files.check: Push in upright, turn to horizontal. Note: turns by hand? clicks? wobbles? C is the tightest.

files.name: Hook
files.check: Hang a 2 kg bag from it for 24 h on the coupon; check for creep or the key turning.

files.name: Over-door hanger
files.check: Hook over your real door, close the door, check it still latches.

files.name: Pocket clearance coupon (180 × 123 mm)
files.check: Drop a $2 coin and an AA battery in each column. Pick the tightest column where both drop in and lift out easily: that's the clearance for cut-out trays.

files.name: Door gap gauge (2–6 mm)
files.check: Close the door and slide the gauge into the gap above it. If the 4 step fits, the over-door hanger will too.
